shellCommands.command: cat package.json && ls && ls src 2>/dev/null; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui 2>/dev/null; sed -n 1,60p .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md; rg -n -i -C3 "chartkit|charts" .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md | head -80

rg -n -C2 -i "yagr" .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md | sed -n 1,80p; cat AGENTS.md; cat src/App.tsx src/main.tsx tsconfig.json vite.config.ts; ls src/*; ls __agent_eval__; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/package.json | grep '"version"'

npm install @gravity-ui/yagr 2>&1 | tail -8; grep '"version"\|peerDep' -A4 node_modules/@gravity-ui/yagr/package.json | head -30; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/yagr node_modules/@gravity-ui/yagr/dist/docs node_modules/@gravity-ui/yagr/build/docs 2>&1 | head -40

git diff --stat; wc -l node_modules/@gravity-ui/yagr/README.md; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/yagr/dist node_modules/@gravity-ui/yagr/typings; grep -n '"main"\|"module"\|"types"\|"exports"' -A6 node_modules/@gravity-ui/yagr/package.json | head -30; sed -n 1,140p node_modules/@gravity-ui/yagr/README.md
cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/yagr/dist && cat react.d.ts; wc -l index.d.ts types.d.ts; cat index.d.ts | sed -n 1,200p

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/yagr/dist && cat YagrCore/index.d.ts | grep -v '^\s*/\?\*' | sed -n 1,140p; cat react.mjs | head -150; cat index.css | head -30; grep -n "dark\|--yagr" index.css | head -30

grep -n "src/react.tsx" -A0 react.mjs; awk '/\/\/ src\/react.tsx/{f=1} f' react.mjs | grep -n "var YagrReact\|forwardRef" | head; awk '/var YagrReact|YagrReact = /{f=1} f' react.mjs | head -120; grep -v '^\s*/\?\*' YagrCore/mixins/dynamic-updates.d.ts; grep -v '^\s*/\?\*' YagrCore/plugins/legend/legend.d.ts | sed -n 1,50p

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules && cat @gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/theme/useThemeType.d.ts; grep -n "incremental" -B4 -A40 @gravity-ui/yagr/dist/yagr.mjs | sed -n 1,140p; grep -n "setTheme(" -A25 @gravity-ui/yagr/dist/yagr.mjs | head -50

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/yagr && sed -n 25,60p package.json; grep -n "class ColorParser" -A40 dist/yagr.mjs | head -70; grep -n "DEFAULT_X_SCALE =\|DEFAULT_Y_SCALE =" dist/yagr.mjs; grep -v '^\s*/\?\*' dist/YagrCore/plugins/tooltip/types.d.ts | sed -n 1,60p

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/yagr/dist && grep -n "parse(" -B2 -A22 yagr.mjs | sed -n 1,60p; grep -n "interface TooltipOptions" -A40 YagrCore/plugins/tooltip/types.d.ts | grep -v '^\S*\s*/\?\*' | head -40

python3 - <<'EOF'
p='src/monitoring/CpuChart.tsx'
s=open(p).read()
s=s.replace("""    timeline: buffer.timeline,
    series: [""","""    // Yagr mutates its config on incremental updates, so it must own its copies.
    timeline: [...buffer.timeline],
    series: [""").replace("        data: buffer.values,\n","        data: [...buffer.values],\n")
open(p,'w').write(s)
EOF
npm run build 2>&1 | tail -15; git status --short
npm run build 2>&1 | tail -6; rm -rf dist; git status --short
